Mini-batch loaders

Source: R/graph-sampling.R
node_loader.Rd

node_loader() splits seed nodes into batches and samples each batch's neighborhood with sample_neighbors(). graph_loader() splits a list of graphs (or a graph_dataset()) into graph_batch() objects. Call loader_batches() to draw the batches of one epoch; with a seed, epoch e uses seed seed + e, so every epoch differs but runs are reproducible.

Usage

node_loader(
  g,
  nodes = NULL,
  batch_size = 64L,
  fanouts = c(10L, 10L),
  shuffle = TRUE,
  seed = NULL
)

graph_loader(dataset, batch_size = 32L, shuffle = TRUE, seed = NULL)

loader_batches(loader, epoch = 1L)

Arguments

g

A graph_data object.

nodes

Seed nodes; default the training mask (or all nodes).

batch_size

Seeds or graphs per batch.

fanouts

Fanout per hop, see sample_neighbors().

shuffle

Shuffle before splitting into batches.

seed

Optional integer seed.

dataset

A list of graph_data objects or a graph_dataset.

loader

A loader.

epoch

Epoch number, used to derive the epoch seed.

Value

A loader object; use loader_batches() to get batches.

Examples

g <- dataset_karate()
ld <- node_loader(g, nodes = 1:20, batch_size = 8, fanouts = c(5, 5), seed = 1)
length(loader_batches(ld, epoch = 1))
#> [1] 3
